erin (sales): Sentinel wants a short perf check: sustained 300 qps gen-only for 20m, p95 < 280ms, and an estimate for worst-case cost if fallback to smaller model happens. Can eng confirm run?
sam (eng-sre): Plan: 10m ramp, 20m steady, open loop. Route to dedicated-smallpool (model: redwood-vicuna-13b-q4). We'll trigger fallback by throttling pool at +12m.
nora (solutions): Add: client requires session stickiness for streaming sessions. Clarify whether streaming reconnects preserve token continuity.
sam (eng-sre): Streaming reconnects rehydrate KV cache per session id when available; reconnects during fallback may see warmup tail. We'll measure.
perf-bot: run_id=sent-1769995001 | start=2025-06-18T12:02:01Z | profile=ramp10m-steady20m | qps=300
sam (eng-sre): Load command:
```
spinload --endpoint https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate \
  --open-loop --ramp 10m --duration 20m --qps 300 --concurrency 2500 \
  --payload ./sentinel_prompt.json
```
erin (sales): Capture tokens consumed and a back-of-envelope customer-facing cost delta for fallback.
sam (eng-sre): Snapshot @ +8m: p50=34ms p95=210ms p99=540ms errs=0. GPU util 79%. Cache hit 66%.
perf-bot: simulate=partial-throttle | target_pool=dedicated-smallpool | removed=50% | ts=2025-06-18T12:20:00Z
sam (eng-sre): Induced throttle at +18m. Observed fallback to vicuna-13b-int8. p95 rose to 360ms for ~90s, p99 to 1.2s, errors stayed <0.3%. Cache hit dropped to 38%.
nora (solutions): For customer note: availability maintained; short tail increase during fallback. Recommend pre-warm standby + 1.5x burst capacity for SLAs.
erin (sales): (typo fixed) Thanks. Can you give a simple line for the quote: "Expected per-token cost +~20% during fallback"?
sam (eng-sre): Yes, ballpark +20% per-token due to smaller-model inefficiency and cache miss. Final run: p50=33ms p95=220ms overall, total tokens ~4.1M.
erin (sales): Great. I'll send sanitized graphs and the one-liner cost note. end thread.
